name: shinchantw_cbt_event_coverage_20260729_160058_059037
sql:
/* Diagnostic only: discover actual guide/activity event names and populated guide fields. */
SELECT
    "$part_date" AS "日期",
    "$part_event" AS "分区事件",
    "#event_name" AS "事件名称",
    COUNT(*) AS "事件次数",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "#distinct_id") AS "设备数",
    COUNT_IF(gamer_guide_id IS NOT NULL) AS "guide_id非空次数",
    COUNT_IF(gamer_skip IS NOT NULL) AS "guide_skip非空次数"
FROM ta.v_event_18
WHERE "$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-07-29' AND '2026-07-29'
  AND (
      LOWER("$part_event") LIKE '%guide%'
      OR LOWER("#event_name") LIKE '%guide%'
      OR gamer_guide_id IS NOT NULL
  )
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 4 DESC;
